description: This file defines retry-related utilities, including specific delay strategies and a helper class to perform retry logic with exception handling, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: RetryOperation
classes.description: Contains delay strategies like sigmoid and linear delay curves for retries.

classes.name: RetryHelper
classes.description: Provides a method to perform asynchronous retries of operations with configurable delay, exception handling, and cancellation support.

methods.name: Sigmoid
methods.description: Generates a sigmoid-shaped delay based on the retry attempt number, capped at 50 seconds.

methods.name: LinearWithTenMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns a linear delay of 10 milliseconds multiplied by the retry attempt number.

methods.name: RetryOnExceptionAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous retry of a given operation, with configurable maximum attempts, delay strategy, and cancellation support.
